method: Stock wall time divided by Ohm wall time within the same project, workflow, phase and repetition. Ablation references are the explicitly named disabled-feature configuration. The geometric mean is exp(mean(log(ratio))). The two-sided 95% interval uses the paired log-ratio sample deviation and Student t with n-1 degrees of freedom. Intervals are per case. There is no interval for a one-pair case. The original public tables use their documented medians or means.
screen: Flag when Ohm takes at least one second and at least 5% longer than current stock, or its median grows at least one second while relative speedup drops at least 10% from the published prior campaign. Historical ratios serve as a screen for matched same-host release comparisons. The uv ablation compares feature settings within one Ohm release and is excluded from this screen.
